permissionDenied.title: Ntibiboneka kuri uru ruhare rw'igerageza
permissionDenied.body: Uruhare rw'igerageza rwa {{role}} ntirushobora gufungura iyi paji. Iki gikorwa cyanditswe mu gitabo cy'igenzura.

notFound.title: Paji ntiyabonetse
notFound.description: Iyi aderesi ntihuye n'ipaji iyo ari yo yose muri iri gerageza.

routeError.title: Iyi paji ntiyashoboye kugaragara
routeError.description: Habaye ikibazo mu kugaragaza iyi paji. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa usubize igerageza uko ryari riri ukoresheje Ibikoresho by'igerageza.
